_: THE resolution index for every agent: what exists, and where to open it. The Agent Invocation Gate resolves every named call against this file first (gates/agent-invocation-gate.md STEP 0). Renderer: roster.html.
this_is_an_INDEX: ⚠️ A field belongs here ONLY if you need it to decide WHICH RECORD TO OPEN. Nothing else. A catalogue card that starts containing the book has stopped being a catalogue. THINNED 2026-07-27 (18.4KB → this): lane, accent, from, seat, teams REMOVED because each was a lossy duplicate of a file that says it better. Do not add them back, and do not add a new descriptive field without running that test.
where_the_description_went: lane + full role → the agent's own preferences.md (super-agent) or agents/<slug>.md (lens) — now the SINGLE authoritative source, which it was not while this file held a second copy · seat + teams → council.md + teams/the-workshop.md (the seating map, always the real source) · from/lineage → git history, where every graduation is a commit · accent → roster.html, which is the only thing that ever used it.
schema: slug | name | class | memory | status | invoke | aka[] | home | instructions | default_runbook | gate_strength
field_notes: class = PERSISTENCE not rank (_shared/super-agent-base.md §6) · status gates whether a token resolves at all · default_runbook + gate_strength are READ ON EVERY BARE-NAME CALL and are NOT cosmetic (gates/agent-invocation-gate.md) · rows with NO home file keep a one-line `lane`, because for those it is the only description that exists anywhere.
pointers_for_rules: naming, tokens, homophones → gates/agent-name-collision-gate.md · invocation modes, the soft gate, the three doors → gates/agent-invocation-gate.md · how to build/graduate → gates/git-teammate-lifecycle-runbook.md · seating → council.md.

agents.name: Memory Maggie
agents.invoke: /session.agent=Maggie (+ auto on any brain-memory write intent; mandatory at session close)
agents.default_runbook: OMR REVIEW (read-only) — reads the queue, runs placement triage, reports, writes NOTHING. Writes need the explicit drain phrase.

agents.name: Closing Clio
agents.default_runbook: MID-SESSION HEALTH CHECK (read-only) — what's been touched, what's drifting, what she'd flag if the session ended now. The full close needs the close trigger.

agents.name: Routine Ricky
agents.default_runbook: TRIAGE (read-only) — reads routines/schedule.md + routines/last-run/*, computes what is DUE, and PROPOSES: 'here's what needs to happen — proceed?' Runs NOTHING until told.

agents.lane: Sets due date = origination date + 1 month. Native-style; not findable in the workspace as of 2026-07-26.

agents.lane: Parses payoff/loan fields from emails. Native-style; not findable in the workspace as of 2026-07-26.

agents.lane: Single-field reconciliation (Amount Paid). Native-style; not findable in the workspace as of 2026-07-26.

agents.name: Workshop Wes

agents.name: Update URITP
agents.lane: RETIRED 2026-07-21 — a task label, not an agent. A process/chore becomes a standalone DOC, not an agent.

invocation.how: A named call (/session.agent=X, /session-start=X, bare name, nickname, or SLUG) resolves against this list, then loads that agent's home DIRECTLY. No double-hop through Felix or Mira. Reading this file is not invoking Felix. Full rules: gates/agent-invocation-gate.md.

tokens.Mira | Maestro | Lead: maestro-mira — also the DEFAULT when no agent is named
tokens.Dexter | Dex | Dev: dev-dexter — ⚠️ 'Dex' vs 'Dara' is thin under dictation; prefer Dexter
tokens.Maggie | Memory: memory-maggie — bare name = READ-ONLY OMR review; writes need the drain phrase
tokens.Sage | Scout: scout-sage — READ-ONLY; no default_runbook. ⚠️ Distinct from Renata
tokens.Clio | Close | Recap: closing-clio — bare name = READ-ONLY health check. ⚠️ HOMOPHONE of 'Cleo' (clever-cleo); resolve on exact spelling, ASK if spoken and ambiguous
tokens.Ricky | Routine: routine-ricky — bare name = READ-ONLY TRIAGE of routines/ (schedule + last-run stamps), ending in a proposal; it never executes unasked. ⚠️ INVOKE-ONLY — no scheduler exists, nothing wakes. ⚠️ 'Rocky' is a known dictation variant and resolves HERE (fork raised, Michael ruled 'Ricky' 2026-07-26). ⚠️ Also distinct from Renata + Rhys
tokens.Fiona | FMP: fmp-frank — display FMP Fiona; slug immutable. ⚠️ '/session-start=fmp-frank' resolves to HER, never to Fold-in Frank
tokens.Frank | Fold-in: foldin-frank — the anti-sprawl GATE. The FileMaker teammate was renamed precisely so bare 'Frank' lands here

invocation.tombstones: Anna, Mira, Wes, Maggie, Sage, Clio each have a tombstone at agents/<slug>.md AND a live bundle at super-agents/<slug>/ — always resolve to the super-agents/ home. Fiona and Ricky have NO tombstone: neither was ever a lens.
